newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU sales of wide-screen TVs growing.
newsitem.headline: EU sales of wide-screen TVs growing.

text.p: Sales of wide-screen televisions in the European Union are doubling every year and should reach 1.3 million in 1997, the European Commission said on Thursday.
The Commission attributed part of the growth to a European Union action plan that has allocated 228 million ecus ($244 million) since 1993 to promote broadcasts in the cinema-style 16:9 format.
It said in a statement that it had allocated a final 17.3 million ecus ($18.5 million) to help producers and broadcasters make and transmit wide-screen programmes through the end of 1998.
It said it would also provide 1.4 million ecus ($1.5 million) to help Television Radio Services 98 transmit next year's World Cup football match in France in wide-screen format.
In all, the action plan will have funded 60,000 hours of wide-screen broadcasts and 23,000 hours of new or remastered programmes, the Commission said.
